label.zh: DFM 技术报告（9 月 15 日开放）

zh.title: 从完成科研任务到参与科学发现：PhAI Labs 发布 DFM 技术框架
zh.summary: DFM，全称 Discovery Foundation Models，是 PhAI Labs 面向科学发现提出的技术框架与系统蓝图。围绕这一蓝图，各项能力将通过具体模块逐步实现并陆续发布。
body: 2026 年 9 月 15 日，PhAI Labs 发布面向科学发现的 DFM 技术框架，并同步启动 DFM科学家合作计划。
DFM 全称 Discovery Foundation Models，是 PhAI Labs 面向科学发现提出的技术框架与系统蓝图。DFM 关注的不只是让 AI 更快地完成既有科研任务，而是让系统参与更完整的科学发现过程：识别有价值的未知；将未知转化为可研究的问题；构建并修正研究假设；调用科研工具、数据和实验环境；根据外部证据验证和更新判断；沉淀可复用的研究结构与发现能力。
围绕这一框架，相关能力将通过具体模块逐步实现并陆续发布。本次发布同步展示 DFM 框架下的两个模块：ScienceBuddy · AI 科研搭档，科学家可以直接使用的智能研究工作环境；SciXXX · 科学加速框架，面向真实科学代码库与研究任务的可验证研究环境。JEPA Anything 等后续模块将陆续公布。
DFM 技术报告与 GitHub 仓库将于 9 月 15 日开放。技术报告、开源清单、模块开放范围和后续路线，将在内部确认后陆续补充。
DFM科学家合作计划同日启动，为 DFM 引入真实且重要的科学问题、高价值研究数据、可交互的科研环境、实验和专家反馈，以及能够检验系统判断的真实验证条件。首期重点关注生命科学与生物医学，同时面向化学、材料及其他前沿领域开放。

en.title: From completing tasks to participating in discovery: PhAI Labs releases the DFM technical framework
en.summary: Discovery Foundation Models (DFM) is PhAI Labs’ technical framework and system blueprint for scientific discovery. Its capabilities will be progressively implemented and released as concrete modules.
body: On 15 September 2026, PhAI Labs releases DFM, its technical framework for scientific discovery, and launches the DFM Scientist Collaboration Program.

Discovery Foundation Models (DFM) is PhAI Labs’ technical framework and system blueprint for scientific discovery. DFM is concerned not only with making AI faster at existing research tasks, but with letting a system take part in the fuller process of discovery: identifying valuable unknowns; turning them into researchable questions; building and revising hypotheses; calling research tools, data and experimental environments; validating and updating its judgement against external evidence; and accumulating reusable research structure and the capacity to discover.

Around this framework, the capabilities will be progressively implemented and released as concrete modules. This release shows two modules under DFM: ScienceBuddy · AI Research Partner, a research workspace scientists can use directly; and SciXXX · Scientific Acceleration Framework, verifiable research environments built from real scientific codebases and tasks. JEPA Anything and further modules will follow.

The DFM technical report and GitHub repositories open on 15 September. The report, the open-source inventory, the scope of each module and the roadmap beyond will be added as they are confirmed internally.

The DFM Scientist Collaboration Program launches the same day. It brings DFM real and consequential scientific questions, high-value research data, interactive research environments, experimental and expert feedback, and real verification conditions that can test the system’s judgement. The first cohort prioritizes life science and biomedicine, while remaining open to chemistry, materials and other frontier fields.
